text:
alice.j: Scanner pipeline failed on main while uploading SBOM — job hit deadline and KMS decrypt errors. Also Snyk flagged CVE-2026-1234 in a transitive dep (util-crypto). Need remediation priority and a triage plan.

alice.j: Logs:
```
2026-03-20T03:42:11Z ERROR: sbom-uploader: failed to decrypt key: AccessDeniedException: Caller does not have permission to use kms key alias/redwood/sbom
  at api/storage/upload.go:201
  ...
ci-bot: Job 4721 canceled due to deadline exceeded (1200s)
```

maria: @alice.j this looks like the CI runner SA lost kms:Decrypt on the sbom key after the policy cleanup yesterday. I'll check IAM audit.

ben_sec: Can you paste the job link and the vuln details? Is GHAS showing reachable path?

alice.j: https://ci.internal/runs/4721
Snyk report: "CVE-2026-1234 - util-crypto < 3.0.2 - crypto key parsing RCE" severity: medium
GHAS SARIF: shows same vuln as high with reachability via org-utils -> parser -> util-crypto
Trivy ignore file contains a suppression for older path `org-utils:2.0.0`. Not applicable here.

snyk-bot: New issue detected: CVE-2026-1234 in util-crypto 3.0.1 (transitive). Fix available in 3.0.2. https://snyk.internal/issue/1234

devops_tom: Short-term: we can re-run the job against an encrypted key with a fallback bucket that has no kms. But better to fix IAM. Maria, can you revert the policy change or re-add roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter for the runner SA?

maria: Confirmed: policy change removed role binding to `ci-runner-sa@project`. Re-applying roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter now.

ben_sec: For vulnerability prioritization: if GHAS has a reachable path and it's RCE, I'd bump to P1 and schedule an immediate backport to the last two releases. If it's only reachable in parsing of untrusted input from external users, also P1.

alice.j: I ran local tests: upgrading util-crypto -> 3.0.2 fixes vuln but there is an API change in parser.*. Tests in service-x fail; needs minor code changes but low risk. Also we should remove the stale trivy suppression.

maria: KMS role applied. Re-triggered job 4722.

ci-bot: Job 4722 started
ci-bot: Job 4722 succeeded — SBOM uploaded to gs://sbom-artifacts (encrypted)

alice.j: Re-ran scanners; GHAS and Snyk both report the vuln as resolved on main now.

devops_tom: Action items:
- alice.j: create PR to bump util-crypto to 3.0.2 + adapt parser API (target: next sprint)
- alice.j/ben_sec: prepare emergency backport PRs for v1.12/v1.11 if exploitability confirmed (track as SEC-428)
- infra/maria: add automated test in CI to check KMS permissions after IAM changes (low-ff test)
- remove stale trivy suppression for org-utils 2.0.0

ben_sec: +1. Marking P1 until backports merge.

alice.j: Thanks — will open PRs and link to this thread. Closing once backports exist or exploitability disproved. :eyes:
